query:
UPDATE projects
        SET 
            name = $1,
            description = $2,
            budget_allocated = $3,
            funding_sources = $4,
            focus_area = $5,
            location_metadata = $6,
            start_date = $7,
            end_date = $8,
            status = $9::project_status,
            sector_type = $10,
            risks_and_mitigations = $11,
            assumptions = $12,
            outcomes_and_indicators = $13,
            total_income = $14,
            donor_name = $15,
            project_leader_id = $16
        WHERE id = $17
